name: emulator-extended-controls
description: Emulator Extended Controls adds Android Studio–style emulator controls directly into VS Code’s debug toolbar. Quickly manage Dark Mode, Font Size, Display Size, Layout Bounds, Screen Recording, Screenshots, and more without leaving your editor.The extension integrates seamlessly with VS Code’s floating debug toolbar and supports multiple connected Android devices and emulators with instant device switching. Users can also enable optional quick-action toolbar buttons for frequently used controls.Built for Flutter and Android developers who want faster access to emulator tools while staying entirely inside VS Code.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
